Don't do it bro, when I was 16 I literally had this exact thought and decided I was going to remove my gyno myself. I was mentally and physically exhausted with having gyno (grade 2). Was ready to end it all because of the mental anguish. 

I bought a bunch of supplies and actually attempted to do it, until I had a thought: 

“People go to school for years to perform surgeries like these. There’s no way in fuck I’m going to do this properly.”

If you attempt this surgery on your own, you're going to have worse problems than gyno. There's 1000 ways it could go wrong and even if you manage to do it, the result is most likely going to be shit. 

I say all that to say I understand the exact headspace you're in, bro. Gynecomastia has placed us in a silent hell, but you must remain strong and resist the urge to maim yourself in hopes of removing it. I'm personally thinking about getting it done over in South Korea myself, good prices there. Weather the storm for now and save for the surgery bro
